correctness.rationale: The four-state matrices enumerate every indexed cyclic predecessor via trace. For a word with at least one one, cyclic trace and the coordinatewise max envelope imply the uniform bound u_n; the update of the envelope is checked algebraically. The all-zero block has characteristic recurrence t_n, and t_n-u_n is strictly positive by three positive seeds and the same recurrence. Independent exact Python and C++ programs recheck all families of claims at finite orders. Infinite quantifiers follow from induction, not test coverage.

value.rationale: The exact unique mode and its full integer fiber sequence describe a global property of the one-step output probability distribution on every finite periodic ring, a standard finite-volume model for a nonlinear cellular automaton. Unlike a single example or table, the result gives the complete all-order extremal structure, a universal separation bound and a short structural certificate based on a nonlinear envelope. It is mathematically meaningful even though it does not classify all fibers.
